channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Shape from Einstein problem reveals unexpected physics
item.description: A mathematical shape known for covering surfaces without repeating has shown an unexpected ability to twist light into unusual chiral patterns.

item.title: Major brain changes found between ages 50 and 75
item.description: Scientists have identified extensive changes in how the human brain organizes its genome starting in midlife, offering new insights into aging.

item.title: Chocolate scent linked to more reps with less fatigue in men
item.description: A study found that smelling chocolate allowed men to perform more leg extensions without increased exertion, with dark chocolate having a notable effect.

item.title: Australian cave reveals 25,000 years of ritual use
item.description: Microscopic plant remains show how GunaiKurnai ancestors used Cloggs Cave for rituals over millennia, with evidence of deliberate activities.
